common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one small transparent UI mascot icon for Ocean Buddy. Use the attached reference sheet only for Poulpy's identity: joyful male orange octopus, huge bright blue eyes, rounded compact body, charming smile, blue and orange palette, polished soft 3D illustration. New single character, full body plus only necessary sport equipment, centered square composition filling 85% of frame, clean simple silhouette readable at 40px. Genuine transparent background, no scenery beyond a tiny splash when needed, no text, no label, no extra characters, no thick sticker outline. Eight tentacles total, naturally some occluded; no human limbs, no eyelashes or feminine makeup. Correct equipment geometry, no intersections. At most one cap and one brim, never mix front panel and backward adjustment strap on the same side.

variants.paddle: Poulpy standing on a small turquoise stand-up paddleboard, happy open smile, wearing teal buoyancy vest, no cap. Holding one single-bladed paddle upright on viewer RIGHT; shaft and blade fully OUTSIDE the right outline of the board, paddle blade touches a tiny splash, NEVER passes through board. Three-quarter view, compact.
